name: Anonymous
text: We put two padel courts on a tennis court at ours. The patio's gone. Nobody has forgiven anybody.

author: terry
text: Tennis. Biggest. Said so in 1998 and nobody needed a website.

name: Kath, padel section
text: The walls are part of the court. Next question.

author: jake
text: Our socials are tennis, padel and pickleball on the same night too. [Rallio](https://rallio.io/mixers/) sorts the courts for all three. The bar argument it can't help with.
